prompt: Some people say that the bicycles are a good, modern means of transportation. Other say riding a bicycle has clear disadvantages. Discuss both view points and give your own opinion.
essay:
Riding a bicycle for transportation to a specific place for other people is a good idea. And for others, it’s not, because of the negative effects that can happen while riding it. In this essay, I will discuss my opinions and the advantages and disadvantages.

To begin with, a lot of people are using bicycles to reach their destinations. It has advantages; for instance, in Singapore, the government encourages people to ride. Because it helps the environment by not adding pollution, and at the same time, it is good for physical health. Moreover, the pavements and roads in Singapore are clean and organized. Also, it’s a small country where people can walk or run for a few minutes to the nearby stations. The advantages of riding bicycles are that they help take care of nature and the Earth. Also, it helps our physical bodies live longer lives.

On the contrary, bicycles are not for far destinations, where riding the train and bus is preferable. Furthermore, sometimes the weather is unpredictable; using a bicycle is not recommended when there’s a storm because it can cause harm to the rider and lead to road accidents. In addition to that, not all countries are like Singapore, where roads are clean and safe. Even though it’s good for health, riding for longer hours can make the person tired, and the bicycle can break.

To conclude, riding bicycles is okay if going to nearby places or just touring inside the park for leisure and happy moments. But for going to farther places, trains and buses should be taken for their safe and fast service.
